body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction targets you while you have an Adaptation, before its roll. Response (unopposed): Retain or end that Adaptation; gain +1 to the targeted Defense against the Action.

surges.html: Detect the attacker's space if it is within 3 units and not behind a solid barrier.
If you ended the Adaptation, reduce Damage from the Action by 1.
